textbookBox.concept: A conjunction joins words or sentences: and, but, or, because, although. She was tired but she kept walking.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A conjunction joins words or sentences: and, but, or, because, although. She was tired but she kept walking.

beats.en: A determiner comes before a noun: a, an, the, this, that, some, many, my. It tells which or how many.
beats.speakEn: A determiner comes before a noun: a, an, the, this, that, some, many, my. It tells which or how many.
